accounting.note: The authority on disk still reads runsPerformed 0.  It was never updated, because the run died before it could write its result document, and it is left byte-unchanged rather than corrected.  The marker is what spent the attempt and it is the number to believe.

appendOnly.policy: This record is added.  Nothing already sealed is edited, moved or re-hashed, and the digests below are re-derived from the files as they stand.

appendOnly.why: The first record and its ruling are still true about the first dispatch.  This record is about the second one and revises neither.

boundaries.whyImageProducedIsFalse: Three files were written and passed the content check, and then the run died and the runner was destroyed with them.  No image survives, no digest of one was ever recorded, and nothing downstream may treat this as a produced image.

cause.class: a line that had never been executed, on the one path that only runs once
cause.consumers: none.  `outputManifest` appears exactly once in the repository -- at the line that raised.  Nothing reads it.
cause.error: ValueError: dictionary update sequence element #0 has length 1; 2 is required
cause.what: manifest_from_directory returns a mapping of output name to digest.  Iterating a mapping yields its keys, so each `row` was the string "guest-kernel", and dict() of a string tries to read its characters as pairs.
cause.whyTheTestsMissedIt: Nothing executed produce() past the marker.  The single test that names produce() checks its signature and raises TypeError before the body runs, so the result document had never been assembled by any test.  182 tests in that gate, and none of them reached the line.

consumedMarker.readFrom: the job console, both replicas, in full
consumedMarker.whyItSurvived: The upload that was supposed to keep this file failed.  The marker was written by root at mode 0600 and the upload action runs as the runner account, so it was refused with EACCES on both replicas.  The marker was also echoed to the console when it was written, and that copy is what answers the accounting question.

evidence.runLog: the complete job log of run 33174443939, kept outside the repository

theThreeFilesExisted.how: The statement that raised is the one immediately after manifest_from_directory returned.  That helper opens each of the three named outputs, refuses a name that is not a regular file and refuses one that is zero bytes, and hashes what it reads.  It returned, so all three existed and were non-empty on both replicas.
theThreeFilesExisted.whatItDoesNotEstablish: what those files hashed to.  The digests were computed inside the run and died with it, so there is no digest of a produced file anywhere -- not in a record, not in an artifact, not in the log.

twoReplicasAgreedBeforeTheCrash.what: Both replicas ran the sealed preflight inside the production unit and produced byte-identical result documents.  The determinism this wave depends on held up to the point the run died.
twoReplicasAgreedBeforeTheCrash.whyItIsNotAProductionClaim: Agreeing about a measurement of an assembled tree is not agreeing about three image files.  The compare job never ran, and no image digest exists to compare.

operatorRuling.spendingRule: If the marker is written in the new production and it then fails, the new opportunity is spent too.  Nothing boots until the three files of both replicas match byte for byte and the result is preserved.
operatorRuling.what: The operator confirmed the attempt above as spent and granted exactly one further production attempt, conditional on the repair below landing on main first.

relatedDefectsFoundInTheSameRun.kept: the console echo, which is why the accounting question is answerable at all
relatedDefectsFoundInTheSameRun.what: The marker is written 0600 by root, and the artifact upload runs as the runner account.  Both replicas failed the upload with EACCES.
relatedDefectsFoundInTheSameRun.wouldCost: on a future attempt whose console is truncated or lost, the accounting question would have no answer

relatedDefectsFoundInTheSameRun.what: The steps that keep the manifest, the evidence and the three files ran only on success.  This run built all three, passed the content check, and then discarded them because a later statement raised.
relatedDefectsFoundInTheSameRun.wouldCost: an attempt that produces a good image and loses it, which is what happened here
